messages.text: Map the chain from a AI market requirement to a measurable parameter and then to a required capability of Oscilloscope.

| AI market requirement | Measurable parameter / test item | Required Oscilloscope capability supported by passages | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| AI / data center infrastructure is framed around **Connectivity**, **Power**, and **Resilience** requirements. | For high-speed electrical interfaces, the validation context includes **Interface Test**. | Oscilloscope must serve in **Interface Test** alongside BERTs, AWGs, and switch matrices. | [17][4][6] |
| AI server / PCB trend pushes PCB toward **high layer count, large area, and high-speed transmission**. | Signal-integrity flow for high-speed PCB/PCBA includes **IL / Xtalk / Eye diagram** and **TDR Impedance**. | Oscilloscope capability needed: support high-speed digital signal-integrity validation at least at the level of **eye-diagram / interface-test observation**; the passages do not provide scope bandwidth, sample rate, or pass/fail limits. | [73][6][59] |
| AI / data center infrastructure includes a **Power** requirement. | Slide 11 lists **Power Distribution Network** as a validation block. | Oscilloscope must support **PDN-related measurement**; passages only state scopes and network analyzers are used for PDN, without target impedance, method, or oscilloscope option details. | [17][4][6][59] |
| AI server PCBA / power-supply mapping lists power integrity needs such as **power rail**, **multiphase DC**, and **PI**. | Measurable power items include **power rail / multiphase DC / PI**. | Oscilloscope-family mapping is represented by **MXO** for power rail, multiphase DC, and PI, but the knowledge base does not state option codes, fixtures, or formal oscilloscope specifications. | [8][12][66][64] |
【推論】A minimal traceable chain is: AI data center **Connectivity** need → high-speed interface / eye-diagram validation → oscilloscope must support interface-test / eye-diagram-oriented high-speed digital validation; however, the passages do not specify oscilloscope bandwidth, sampling rate, jitter floor, probes, or compliance software. [17][4][6][59]  
【推論】A second traceable chain is: AI data center **Power** need → PDN / power-rail / PI measurement → oscilloscope must support PDN or power-rail measurement workflows; the passages do not provide PDN target values or oscilloscope option requirements. [17][4][6][66]

- [[Amphenol XtremePass]] — 來源稱 XtremePass 448G connector solution supports scalable form factors from 32DP to 128DP，並跨 Ethernet、NVLink、PCIe、InfiniBand systems。
- [[OSFP Cable Assemblies]] — 來源稱 OSFP cable assemblies compatible with 25G/lane NRZ up to 224G/lane PAM4，deliver aggregate bandwidths of 200G、400G、800G and 1.6T per cable assembly，available in Passive and Active variants。

- [[Celerity 224 Gb-s BGA Mezzanine Connectors]] — 來源稱其 designed to support data rates up to 224 Gb/s PAM4。
